authority: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book, printed p. 38 PT-42/PT-44 schematic and p. 36 specifications; Sylvania 1953 7C6 data for internal cathode bond only.

open_items.gap: The loop-to-#2 aerial-transformer interface and #1 bypass are source-traced. v0.43 traces the lower #9 22 kΩ resistor and #11 0.05 µF capacitor terminals to B−. Their opposite ends, #4 oscillator gang, #6–#8 network, #10 oscillator transformer, remaining 7A8 pins, RF behavior and receiver validation remain open.

Both #12 primary/secondary ends, both #14 primary/secondary ends, and #13 grid-return resistor are now source-traced. 7B7 screen/cathode pin wiring, transformer parameters/trimmers, AVC, and full IF behavior remain open.

The upper #14 secondary/#17 terminal/upper 7C6 diode glyph link and #17 return are source-traced. The diode glyph is not assigned to pin 5 or 6; external cathode routing, #16 switch contacts, remaining AVC topology, and behavior remain open.

Factory #25 is source-traced across filtered B+ and B−, and 50L6 screen routing is recorded at glyph level. Output-transformer winding parameters, speaker/model correlation, and complete output behavior remain open.

The complete AC/line topology is now source-traced at schematic-symbol level: plug conductors, #16 switch, #31 across the plug, #30 40/80-ohm branches, #32 shunt, 35Z3 plate feed, B-minus return, and all five series heaters. Numbered tube-socket heater crosswalk, physical switch-lug crosswalk, and chassis isolation/bond evidence remain open.

All 28 represented graph groups and 81 component-terminal memberships reconcile to source-review records through v0.43. The lower #9/#11 oscillator return endpoints are recorded; their opposite ends, #4 gang, #6–#10 converter topology, socket crosswalks, winding parameters and receiver behavior remain open.
Replace reduced-order model with validated tube, transformer and passive SPICE models.

completion_gates.title: Complete source-traced, pin-level PT-44 netlist
completion_gates.acceptance: Every factory component, external tube terminal, winding end, switch contact and return has a source-backed connection or an explicit manufacturer option.

completion_gates.title: Schematic-to-chassis crosswalk
completion_gates.acceptance: Physical component locations and lead dress are cross-checked against adequate chassis evidence; electrical membership remains the authority.
completion_gates.evidence_to_date: The 1941 p.38 underside position figure now locates 27/33 factory component records by 26 numbered callouts. Six components are not shown; the drawing does not define exact 3D coordinates, lead dress, or wire routes.

completion_gates.title: Service measurements have defined test conditions
completion_gates.acceptance: Return reference, instrument loading, operating state and tolerances are verified before factory voltages are used as pass/fail targets.
completion_gates.evidence_to_date: The 1941 p.36 alignment hookup, controls, frequencies, and adjustment order are transcribed. Meter loading, generator level, supply condition during alignment, and voltage tolerances remain unstated.

completion_gates.title: Full receiver behavior correlates to source data
completion_gates.acceptance: Power, heater, RF, IF, detector, AVC and audio operating behavior is validated against service references and independent calculations.

completion_gates.title: Full SPICE model is validated
completion_gates.acceptance: Sourced tube and transformer models, passive values and operating states reproduce documented circuit behavior; the isolated RC deck alone does not satisfy this gate.

completion_gates.title: Repair and fault regressions remain stable
completion_gates.acceptance: Known fault cases remain diagnosable and repairable through the shop workflow after the engineering model is connected to gameplay.

latest_evidence_update: v0.43 traces the lower ends of the #9 22 kΩ resistor and #11 0.05 µF capacitor to the B− rail. Their upper ends, the rest of the #6–#10 oscillator network, 7A8 socket-pin crosswalk and receiver behavior remain open.

model_equivalence_review.finding: Philco historical model documentation says PT-44 and PT-42 have identical chassis; the factory p.38 schematic and chassis locator are labeled for both models.
model_equivalence_review.engineering_effect: Confirms applicability of the existing shared factory source. No net memberships or completion gates are added; exact parts, RF winding terminals, 7A8 pins, and physical coordinates remain source-gated.
additional_leads: Philco Service Bulletin 437 / 365 is indexed for PT-42 and PT-44, but no scan is linked in the online index.
Rider Volume 12 index points to PT-42/PT-44 schematic, socket, trimmer, and chassis data at 12-45; full volume was inaccessible during this review.
